description: Coupled Bianchi-I moduli ODE and stability analysis on T^3

conclusions.free_sector: Free Casimir stress decays to spatial isotropy with negative Lyapunov exponent. No free geometric attractor exists (Scoped Negative).
conclusions.driven_sector: Driven model sustains H_t/H_p ~ 1.055-1.083 conditional on external syntropic pump eta. The linearized modes have negative real parts (-0.038, -2.96), but the exact 13/12 value requires fine-tuned eta = 0.585 rather than 0.375.
